faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.sub: Clear answers before you book — rides, airport transfers, and tours.

fareCalc.a: Taxi fares combine base fare, distance, waiting time, and time-of-day rates. You see a live estimate in the booking flow before you confirm.

airport.q: Can I pre-book an airport transfer?
airport.a: Yes. Use Airport Transfers to request a timed pickup for Bandaranaike (CMB), with flight-aware buffers when you need them.

tour.q: Can I customize my Sri Lanka tour?
tour.a: Yes. Private tours are built around your days, stops, and vehicle — refine the plan with Q Pick before you travel.

vehicle.q: Can I choose my vehicle category?
vehicle.a: Yes. From Q Bike to Q Bus, pick the category that fits passengers and luggage in the booking carousel or Fleet section.

drivers.a: Yes. Q Pick drivers complete identity, vehicle, and background checks before joining the network.

share.q: Can I share my trip with family?
share.a: Yes. Share live trip status so family, friends, or your hotel can follow the journey.

cancel.a: Yes. Cancel from the app or with Support. Timing and any fees depend on the booking type and how close you are to pickup.

contact.a: Reach us anytime via the Support page — phone, WhatsApp, or email. Our team is available 24/7.

finalCta.heading: Still have questions?
finalCta.sub: Our team is available 24/7 to help you plan your ride or your Sri Lanka journey.

book.q: How do I book a ride or transfer?
book.a: Book via the Q Pick app, the Ride page for city trips, Airport Transfers for CMB pickups, or Tours for private journeys. You can also call, WhatsApp, or email our support desk 24/7.

airport.a: Share your flight details when booking. Your chauffeur tracks arrival timing, meets you with a name board when requested, and coordinates the hotel handoff.

payment.q: What payment methods do you accept?
payment.a: Payment options depend on the booking type — card, cash, and corporate billing are supported where available. Support can confirm options for your specific trip.

cancel.a: You can cancel from the app or via Support. Fees depend on how close you are to pickup and the booking category — our team will explain before any charge applies.

refund.a: Eligible refunds are processed after review. Contact Support with your booking reference — we respond quickly and keep you updated through resolution.

corporate.q: How do I open a corporate or hotel partner account?
corporate.a: Email partnerships or call our support line. We assign a dedicated account manager, set up billing preferences, and onboard your front desk or travel team.

hub-customize.question: Can I customise a Q Pick tour package?
hub-customize.answer: Yes. Published packages are starting points. Choose destinations, days, vehicle, and preferences in the planner — our desk refines the route after you submit a request.

hub-price.question: How does pricing work?
hub-price.answer: We show Pricing Available Upon Request until your itinerary is reviewed. After you submit a tour request, Q Pick confirms a written private-chauffeur quote. Entrance fees, safari jeeps, accommodation, and meals are typically separate unless stated in writing.

hub-airport.question: Do you offer airport pickup with tours?
hub-airport.answer: Yes. Bandaranaike International (CMB) pickup and drop-off can be arranged with your tour or via our dedicated airport transfer service.

hub-group.question: Which vehicle should I choose?
hub-group.answer: Sedans suit couples; SUVs and vans fit families; luxury vans and mini coaches serve larger groups. Select capacity in the planner — we confirm the final vehicle after reviewing luggage and route.

hub-payment.question: How do payments and confirmation work?
hub-payment.answer: Submit a tour request online. Our team reviews availability, confirms an outline and quote, then shares next steps for payment and chauffeur assignment. You receive a reference code for tracking.

pkg-3d-pace.question: Is three days enough for the Cultural Triangle?
pkg-3d-pace.answer: Three days can cover Sigiriya, Dambulla, and either Anuradhapura or Polonnaruwa at a composed private pace. Longer stays allow Mihintale, safari add-ons, or a Kandy extension.

pkg-5d-train.question: Can we include the Ella train?
pkg-5d-train.answer: Yes. Many guests ride a scenic rail segment while the chauffeur transfers luggage by road. Tell us your preference when requesting a quote.

pkg-5d-weather.question: What is the weather like in the hill country?
pkg-5d-weather.answer: Nuwara Eliya and Ella are cooler than the coast, with misty mornings and possible light rain. Pack layers; your private vehicle keeps transfers comfortable between viewpoints.

pkg-7d-fitness.question: How much walking is involved on the 7-day tour?
pkg-7d-fitness.answer: Sigiriya and temple visits involve steps; Ella offers optional short walks. Your chauffeur times the day so strenuous segments can be shortened without losing the highlights.

pkg-10d-safari.question: Is a Yala safari included in the wildlife adventure?
pkg-10d-safari.answer: Safari jeep hire and park entry are arranged as add-ons with clear timing. Wildlife sightings are never guaranteed — we plan for the best seasonal window after your request.

pkg-14d-pace.question: Is fourteen days too much driving?
pkg-14d-pace.answer: With a private chauffeur and spaced overnight stops, daily driving stays manageable. We design rest beach days so the itinerary feels immersive, not rushed.

pkg-21d-season.question: When is the best season for a grand island tour?
pkg-21d-season.answer: West and south coasts favour December–March; the east often shines around May–September. A 21-day plan can follow the drier shore — we advise based on your travel month.
